html:
During the summer months on the Gold Coast, most people rely on air conditioning to keep their homes cool. But, did you know that home window tinting Gold Coast not only makes your air conditioning more effective but will also help to keep the heat out? Below, find out more about house window tinting Gold Coast and the types of window tints available in our range.

Tint a Home is Australia’s most trusted tinting network for car, home and office window tinting. We have been providing tinting services in Australia for over 42 years and specialise in both residential window tinting Gold Coast and office window tinting Gold Coast. Here are the benefits of home tinting Gold Coast:

Benefits Of House Window Tinting Gold Coast

The films in our range are designed to reflect heat and glare which helps to keep your home cooler. A reduction in glare also helps to reduce reflections on screens in your home too. Because home tinting Gold Coast adds an insulating layer to your windows, this makes your air conditioning more efficient (it also makes your heating more efficient during the colder months, making your home a more comfortable temperature all year round) … this means you’ll notice a positive difference to your power bills!

Residential window tinting Gold Coast can also make your home safer and secure. Our safety & security films keep shattered glass together which helps to prevent break-ins and reduces the chance of injury if the glass is broken accidentally.

All films in our range are government certified by ARPANSA to ensure the highest quality and protection against the damage caused by UV rays (this also helps to minimise premature fading of flooring and furnishings too).

If you have windows that are street facing or that overlook your neighbours, our privacy films give you the privacy you need during the day whilst still letting in natural light (we do have lighter films if you don’t wish to alter the appearance of your home).

We don’t just do residential window tinting Gold Coast either. With all the benefits above, many businesses choose office window tinting Gold Coast. Reflective window tint is a popular choice as it offers privacy and a sleek/modern aesthetic.

Window Films In Our Range For Home Tinting Gold Coast

  • Solar window films – reflects heat & glare
  • Privacy films – stops those on the outside from seeing into your home
  • Safety films – keeps you and your family safe from breakages
  • Security films – helps to hinder entry into your home from unwanted visitors
  • Decorative films – adds a stylish element to your home whilst offering privacy

Get A Quote For Home Tinting On Gold Coast Today

Call 13 TINT or use our Store Finder to locate your nearest window tinting store to get a quote for residential window tinting Gold Coast or office window tinting Gold Coast. Ask about our zero-interest payment options through Zip Pay or Afterpay.
